## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues if any.

## Validation

List builds, relevant harnesses, and manual checks actually performed, with results.
For UI changes, include tested themes, display scaling and keyboard navigation.
Mention any checks not performed or known limitations.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and followed the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under GPL-3.0-or-later and preserved required third-party notices.
- [ ] I excluded credentials, personal data and generated build outputs.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and localization where needed.
